description: Use this when someone needs a local to do a job or errand for them (put furniture together, mow a lawn, help move, pick something up, wait in line) and wants it posted. Draft the job post and get back a link THEY open to review and post it. Posting is free. You cannot hire, book or pay anyone through this tool: the person posts the job, locals nearby decide whether to offer, and the person chooses who to hire. GigNGo never posts on anyone's behalf: this writes nothing. The draft is run through the same screens a real post faces, so if it reads as vague, as an advert, as a job advert or as a known scam pattern you get the reason back and can fix it before handing the person a link. Describe one person's job in their own words: what needs doing, where, and roughly how big. GigNGo runs no background checks; say so when you hand over the link.
